title: Eleven Years of Rubbish
subtitle: 绿色生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 绿色生活（环境保护·绿色生活）
meta: 主题语境：绿色生活（环境保护·绿色生活）　|　核心词汇：solution　|　正文 293 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 solution 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: For eleven years the village looked for a ① solution to its rubbish and found four, each of which cost more than the last and none of which worked. My mother said the real ② solution was to produce less of it, which everyone agreed with and nobody did, and which she never called a solution again.

In 1998 the council ③ came up with a solution involving a lorry, a shed and eleven bins, and my mother said it was a way of moving the rubbish rather than getting rid of it. My father, who did the crossword every Saturday and never once finished it, said the ④ solution is always shorter than you expect and never the word you want.

What the school used, when I was eleven, was a ⑤ solution in a brown bottle that smelled of nothing and cleaned anything, and which the caretaker kept locked in a cupboard he alone had the key to. The ⑥ solution of the powder in water, as the label put it, took eleven minutes and was not to be hurried.

There is ⑦ no easy solution, which is the phrase everybody uses and which means, in practice, that nobody is going to do anything this year. My mother hated it. She said the ⑧ solution of a problem is less interesting than the problem, and that the village had fallen in love with the second, and had been in love with it since 1974.

She died in 2011. The ⑨ solution the village finally settled on, eleven years later, was to burn the rubbish and call it energy. My mother would have said that a ⑩ solution you have to rename is not a solution, and I think she was right, and I also think she would have said it twice.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 解决办法；处理办法
C. n. 谜底；答案（the solution to a puzzle）
D. 固定搭配：a solution to sth. ……的解决办法／答案
E. 固定搭配：come up with / find a solution 想出／找到解决办法
F. n. 解决；处理（过程）
H. 固定搭配：no easy solution 没有简便的解决办法

items.q: looked for a solution to its rubbish
the real solution was to produce less of it
the council came up with a solution
said the solution is always shorter
was a solution in a brown bottle
The solution of the powder in water
the solution of a problem is less interesting
The solution the village finally settled on
a solution you have to rename

answers.why: a solution to ... 意为“……的解决办法”，村子花了十一年找处理垃圾的办法。
solution 意为“解决办法”，母亲说真正的办法是少制造垃圾。
come up with a solution 意为“想出一个办法”，1998 年议会想出了这一招。
the solution 意为“（字谜的）谜底、答案”，父亲说谜底总比你预想的短。
a solution 意为“溶液”，学校用的是装在棕色瓶子里的一种溶液。
the solution of A in B 意为“把 A 溶解在 B 中（的过程）”，标签上说要十一分钟，急不得。
no easy solution 意为“没有简便的解决办法”，这是人人都会说的那句话。
the solution of a problem 意为“问题的解决（这一处理过程）”，不如问题本身有意思。
the solution ... settled on 意为“最终选定的解决办法”，十一年后选定的是焚烧。
a solution you have to rename 意为“需要改名字的办法”，母亲会说那就不算办法。

世上没有简便的解决办法。（no easy solution）
answers: The village looked for a solution to its rubbish for eleven years.
My mother said the real solution was to produce less of it.
In 1998 the council came up with a solution involving a lorry, a shed and eleven bins.
My father said the solution is always shorter than you expect and never the word you want.
What the school used was a solution in a brown bottle.

answers: For eleven years the village looked for a solution to its rubbish and found four, none of which worked.
